frame: Lifestyle frames carry NO packaging [ADAM 2026-08-16]. Product presence comes from the prepared drink and everyday vessels: a reusable water bottle, a tall glass. Nothing to drift, and none of it needs reshooting when the ecommerce photography lands. Pack only appears where it is the argument: the R01 comparison and the FAQ tear.

not_built.offer-01 / offer-02: Pack shots. Use real ecommerce photography, not generation.
not_built.vid-01 / vid-02 / vid-03: Rebecca's real YouTube thumbnails. Never generated.

editing: Small fixes on an approved frame go through edit.py, which passes the image back with a preservation clause. Never re-run generate.py for a detail change: a fresh generation reshuffles face, pose and light and you lose the frame you already signed off.
